The exclusive-OR graph shows the slope cannot be lower: 4 gates with NOT against exactly 2n - 1 without, a gap of 2n - 5. At side 3 the bound is 1 above; a 3 by 3 graph costing 6 with NOT gates and 8 or more without would break it. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.
changed.sketch: Merge duplicate lines. Restriction costs no gates. Restoring a line costs at most one OR. In the reduced r by c table, two unread lines in a bank would match. At least r+c-2 raw wires reach the output, requiring r+c-3 binary gates. At that budget the source is positive. One gate higher, a live NOT forces a tree with one use per wire and one omitted line per bank. On mask 14303 only full lines can be omitted. Derive a terminal NOT by polarity: a six-gate source would give a five-gate complement, below its checked minimum of six. Then tackle larger budgets.

changed.title: Fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuits count names and schedules satisfying runtime parity observations at bounded observation rank
changed.statement:
∀ (k r s : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun t : Nat => (⟨t % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (amount : Nat) (x : W) (j : Fin k) => x (ix (j.val+k-amount % k))
  let layer := fun (gap : Nat) (x : W) =>
    let m := fun (j : Fin k) => x j + x (ix (j.val+gap)) + x (ix (j.val+k-gap % k))
    fun (j : Fin k) => m j + (1+m (ix (j.val+1))) * m (ix (j.val+2))
  ∀ col : Bool,
    let initial := if col then 3 else 1
    let gap := if col then 2 else 1
    let inject := fun t : Nat => if col then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
    let state := fun (data : W × (Fin r → W)) (key : W) (time : Fin (r+1)) =>
      ((List.finRange r).take time.val).foldl (fun v tick =>
        layer gap v + rot (inject tick.val) key + data.2 tick) (rot initial key + data.1)
    let S := Fin r → W
    let encodeInput := fun (raw : W) (delta : Fin s → W)
      (path : Fin (r+1) → Fin s → W) (test target : W) =>
      let bits := fun (x : W) => (List.finRange k).map (fun j => decide (x j ≠ 0))
      bits raw ++ (List.finRange s).flatMap (fun p => bits (delta p)) ++
      (List.finRange (r+1)).flatMap (fun t =>
        (List.finRange s).flatMap (fun p => bits (path t p))) ++ bits test ++ bits target
    let coords := fun (b : S) => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun t =>
      (List.finRange k).map (fun j => decide (b t j ≠ 0)))
    let hits := fun (raw : W) (delta : Fin s → W) (path : Fin (r+1) → Fin s → W)
      (test target : W) (c : S) =>
      ((Finset.univ : Finset W).filter (fun name =>
        (∀ t p, state (name,c) (raw+delta p) t - state (name,c) raw t = path t p) ∧
        (∀ j, test j ≠ 0 → state (name,c) raw (Fin.last r) j = target j))).card
    let pairing := fun (b c : S) => ∑ t : Fin r, dotProduct (b t) (c t)
    let countBits := (r+1)*k
    let w := Nat.log2 countBits + 1
    let common := (3+s+(r+1)*s)*k
    ∀ q cap : Nat,
      let p := min cap (r*k)
      let inputs := common+q*r*k+q
      let length := countBits+p+3
      ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (overflow : Fin (inputs+C.size))
        (answer : Fin (countBits+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
        C.output = overflow.val ∧
        C.size ≤ 65536*(q+1)*(r*k+2)^3 +
          2^p * (524288*(r+1)*((k+1)*(k+s+p+1)+(w+1)^2) + 256*length^2) ∧
        ∀ (raw : W) (delta : Fin s → W) (path : Fin (r+1) → Fin s → W)
          (test target : W) (obs : Fin q → S) (wanted : Fin q → F),
          let xs := encodeInput raw delta path test target ++
            (List.finRange q).flatMap (fun j => coords (obs j)) ++
            (List.finRange q).map (fun j => decide (wanted j ≠ 0))
          let rank := Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range obs))
          let val : Nat := if rank ≤ cap then
            ∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset S).filter (fun c => ∀ j, pairing (obs j) c = wanted j),
              hits raw delta path test target c
            else 0
          (C.wires xs).getD overflow.val false = decide (cap < rank) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin (countBits+1), (C.wires xs).getD (answer j).val false = val.testBit j.val)

  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))

    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2

    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =

  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool

    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧

      (List.range (m+1)).flatMap (fun j => bits k (count s j % 2^k)))

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit evaluates every weighted fiber of a binary affine relation at the cost of blocked matrix multiplication
changed.statement:
∀ (a b c m t : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin a → F
  let Y := Fin b → F
  let Z := Fin c → F
  let N := a+b+c
  let w := max a (max b c)
  let inputs := m*(N+1)+(2^a+2^b)*t
  let bitsOut := a+b+2*t+1
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (answer : Fin (2^c) → Fin bitsOut → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = (answer 0 0).val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^60*(N+m+t+4)^30*2^(w % 2)*7^(w/2) ∧
    ∀ (H : Fin m → X × Y × Z) (rhs : Fin m → F)
      (f : Fin (2^a) → Fin (2^t)) (g : Fin (2^b) → Fin (2^t)),
      let pack := fun (s : Nat) (v : Fin s → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin s => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun i =>
        pack a (H i).1 ++ pack b (H i).2.1 ++ pack c (H i).2.2 ++ [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++
        (List.finRange (2^a)).flatMap (fun ix => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (f ix).val.testBit j.val)) ++
        (List.finRange (2^b)).flatMap (fun iy => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (g iy).val.testBit j.val))
      let decode := fun (s v : Nat) (j : Fin s) => (if v.testBit j.val then 1 else 0 : F)
      let readWire := fun n : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD n.val false
      let total := fun iz : Fin (2^c) =>
        ∑ ix : Fin (2^a), ∑ iy : Fin (2^b),
          if ∀ i, dotProduct (H i).1 (decode a ix.val) + dotProduct (H i).2.1 (decode b iy.val) +
            dotProduct (H i).2.2 (decode c iz.val) = rhs i then (f ix).val*(g iy).val else 0
      ∀ iz j, readWire (answer iz j) = (total iz).testBit j.val
